supportCenter.name: Name
supportCenter.emergencyText: If anyone is in immediate danger, call police, ambulance, or fire support. After the situation is safe, report the trip details to Yala.

faqs.rideProblemQ: How do I report a problem with a ride?
faqs.rideProblemA: Choose Report a ride issue, add the ride number, pickup, drop-off, driver or rider name, and explain what happened. Safety reports should be sent as soon as possible.
faqs.paymentProblemQ: What should I do for a payment problem?
faqs.paymentProblemA: Use Report payment issue and include the payment method, fare amount, transaction status, and ride number. Admin can compare ride status, payment record, and provider confirmation.
faqs.lostItemQ: How do I recover a lost item?
faqs.lostItemA: Submit a Lost item report with the item description, ride details, and best contact number. Support can help contact the driver using platform records.
faqs.driverPendingQ: Why is my driver account pending or rejected?
faqs.driverPendingA: Driver accounts stay pending until admin approves license, insurance, vehicle registration, profile photo, and identity details. Expired or missing documents can be rejected.
faqs.emergencyQ: Can I call emergency services from the app?
faqs.emergencyA: Yes. Emergency numbers are available below. For immediate danger, call the correct emergency number first, then report the trip to Yala support.
